title: Great Receptacle, Not-So-Great Egg Separator
text:
Great Receptacle, Not-So-Great Egg Separator. Because I regularly make meringue pies and home-made ice cream, I separate a lot of eggs. What I love about this WILTON BETTER BAKING EGG SEPARATOR is the 10-egg-white receptacle that stands firmly on your kitchen countertop--and the snug fit of the egg separator atop the receptacle. What I don't love about it is the design of the egg separator itself.

The egg separator design is fairly standard. There is a central round section for the yolk, with cutouts on both sides that allow the white to slip through. But the central yolk section is not very deep, and is not large enough to allow the yolk to move around. This means that if the white doesn't immediately drop through completely--and you have to gently rotate the yolk to finish the egg-separation process--you are at risk of breaking the yolk and contaminating the whites already in the receptacle. This is especially true if you are working with older eggs that have been in your refrigerator for a while.

Because of the less-than-optimal design, I rate this Wilton Egg Separator at 3 stars ("It's okay" on the official Amazon scale). A couple of egg separators that I like better are the plain, bargain-priced [[ASIN:B0079G2EQ6 Mini Egg Yolk Separator]], and the excellent [[ASIN:B00A2KD8NY OXO Good Grips 3-in-1 Egg Separator]] that hooks onto bowls of all sizes.

description: Separating eggs just became easier and with less mess! Ideal for egg white omelets; cup holds up to 10 egg whites.
